title: Marketplace System Map
description: Interactive map of marketplace models, listing/bid flows, escrow bridge, and capabilities. Pan, zoom, and click nodes for details.

help.title: About Marketplace System Map
help.overview: This map is a read-only picture of the services marketplace: its models, how work and money move between customer and provider, and what the module offers. It changes no data.

sections.title: Model graph
items: Listings with their packages, add-ons, flags, and promotions; task requests and bids; orders with deliveries, milestones, revisions, bookings, disputes, and reviews; provider profiles; and the finance escrow ledger.
Click a node for its description, key fields, API path, actions, and panel page.

sections.title: How it works
items: Buy a listing and task-to-bid-to-order show how an order starts.
Order lifecycle (deliveries, revisions, milestones, auto-accept after 3 days, release minus the fee) and disputes → refund show how it ends.
Moderation & promotion covers reports and boosts; provider onboarding covers profile setup and Stripe Connect payouts.

sections.title: Capabilities
items: What the marketplace supports today, its API areas, scheduled jobs, and storefront routes.
Day-to-day work happens on the Marketplace pages; use the map to onboard staff or plan permissions.
